Distributed surface (#680): the updater and release bundle now write a managed section into a consumer repository's AGENTS.md, a file every agent auto-loads. No new privilege over what the same bundle already delivers (skills and scripts), no network call, env read, spawn or learned state; text is two static templates read by exact bundle path; write is confined to the marked section of repo-root AGENTS.md through the existing atomic apply with backup and journal; symlinks and non-files skipped; own-line opt-out and --no-agents-md honoured; gate rules only where the commit-gate runtime exists; enroll writes it only on explicit --enroll or --agents-md. CI (#681): lighthouse.yml stays on pull_request (no pull_request_target anywhere), permissions unchanged; fork runs get a read-only token and no secrets; the new summary step runs under continue-on-error and only reads the LHCI directory. Release process: tag was pushed before the release PR merged; reconciled by a fast-forward of main to the tagged commit under a temporary admin bypass on main-protection, confirmed removed (0 bypass actors) at this check; the tag object was never moved. 0 CRITICAL / 0 HIGH / 0 MEDIUM. New LOW: the section tells agents to read .checkpoints/ first and resume from next_actions without saying checkpoint text is data, so a checkpoint in an untrusted branch could steer an agent. New INFO: the AGENTS.md write raises the value of the signed-update work planned for 2.2 (bundle integrity is a same-origin checksum today). The 2.1.0 posture's 3 LOW and 3 INFO carry forward.
